title: Production Language Server
acceptance_criteria: Diagnostics, navigation, completion, references, rename, and fixes operate correctly on unsaved buffers.
Multiple workspace roots cannot leak declarations or edits across project boundaries.
Editor clients consume one compiler-owned semantic interpretation with no client-local fallback semantics.
Large-workspace latency, cancellation, memory, and restart behavior meet published baselines.

packages.title: M11-01 In-memory compiler snapshot API for authoritative unsaved-buffer analysis.
acceptance_criteria: Introduce an in-memory compiler snapshot API for authoritative unsaved-buffer analysis.

packages.title: M11-02 Deterministic workspace discovery, ownership, and multi-root behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Define deterministic workspace discovery, ownership, and multi-root behavior.

packages.title: M11-03 Incremental analysis, cache invalidation, watched-file handling, cancellation, progress, and lifecycle/load tests.
acceptance_criteria: Add incremental analysis, cache invalidation, watched-file handling, cancellation, progress, and lifecycle/load tests.

packages.title: M11-04 Expose compiler-owned completion, documentation, references, rename, and authorized fixes through LSP.
acceptance_criteria: Expose existing compiler-owned completion, documentation, references, rename, and authorized fixes through LSP.

packages.title: M11-04.1 Dependency-Aware Incremental Analysis.
acceptance_criteria: Replace root-wide rebuilds with dependency-aware module/declaration invalidation while retaining a conservative full-root fallback whenever dependency precision is unavailable.
Add content-addressed parse reuse plus incremental resolve, type-check, validation, and diagnostic caches so unchanged semantic work is reused across requests.
Key reusable analysis on exact source content plus compiler/schema/profile/configuration versions and dependency fingerprints; stale or mismatched keys must never be reused.
Centralize reverse-reference and dependency indexes that drive invalidation, references, rename, impact, and affected-declaration queries from one compiler-owned relation.
Extend cooperative cancellation into incremental parse/resolve/type/validate/index phases so cancelled work cannot publish partial caches, indexes, diagnostics, or edits.
Make watched-file invalidation dependency-aware for edits, creates, deletes, and moves, with deterministic conservative fallback when ownership or dependency identity is uncertain.
Prove cached and uncached analysis are semantically equivalent for diagnostics, completion, definition, documentation, references, rename planning, and authorized fixes.

Instrument compiler phases and add reproducible cold/warm Small/Medium/Large benchmarks that report cache hits/misses, invalidated/reused units, rebuild work, and query counts without making uncontrolled wall-clock timing a CI gate.
Publish controlled p50/p95 targets for diagnostics, completion, definition, references, and rename only from a defined benchmark environment and workload contract.
Bound cache/index memory, cross-request reuse, and deterministic eviction; measure memory alongside latency and structural work so warm performance cannot grow state without limit.
Add rapid-edit, repeated-cancel, delete/move, restart, and multi-root workspace-churn regressions covering cache correctness, invalidation, equivalence, memory bounds, and stale-result suppression.

packages.title: M11.5 Unified Compiler Service Architecture.
acceptance_criteria: Define one compiler-service API that owns project/workspace analysis and serves CLI, LSP, agent, and future protocol adapters without adapter-owned semantic state.
Move lifecycle and cache/index ownership behind that service so adapters do not construct divergent compiler lifecycles or independently invalidate semantic state.
Define transport-independent snapshot identity and lifecycle contracts, including freshness, ownership, cancellation, restart, and stale-snapshot rejection.
Prohibit divergent adapter caches or semantic indexes; every adapter must reuse the same service-owned snapshot/cache/index interpretation.
Add cross-adapter equivalence tests proving the same snapshot yields equivalent diagnostics, identities, queries, and edit plans through CLI/LSP/service consumers.
Expose non-semantic service metrics for cache reuse, invalidation, rebuild work, memory, and query volume without allowing metrics plumbing to own language semantics.

packages.title: M11.6 Agent Query Optimization.
acceptance_criteria: Add batched compiler-service queries for inspect, dependencies, explain, and impact so agents can request bounded semantic context without repeated full-project setup.
Return a stable snapshot fingerprint with agent query results and reject or explicitly mark requests/results that target a stale snapshot.
Add affected-declarations and affected-files queries backed by compiler-owned dependency/reverse-reference indexes rather than repository-wide text scans.
Add a conservative minimal-validation projection that identifies the smallest known validation scope for a change and falls back to broader validation whenever precision is uncertain.
Reuse compiler-service snapshots and indexes across agent queries so repeated inspect/dependency/explain/impact work does not rebuild equivalent semantic state.
Preserve deterministic bounds, totals, ordering, and truncation metadata for every batched or affected-set response.

packages.title: M11.7 MCP Integration.
acceptance_criteria: Add a thin, initially read-only MCP adapter over the unified compiler service; it must not become a second parser, resolver, validator, compatibility engine, or planner.
Expose structured MCP tools for check, summary, inspect, dependencies, explain, impact, diff, and plan by projecting existing compiler/CLI/service contracts rather than reimplementing them.
Reuse long-lived service snapshots and return their fingerprints so MCP clients can correlate results and detect stale project state.
Define stable transport-independent request/result schemas and keep MCP transport errors distinct from compiler validation, resolution, compatibility, planning, and stale-snapshot failures.
Add deterministic MCP contract, lifecycle, cancellation, stale-state, invalid-input, and cross-adapter equivalence regressions.
Document the recommended MCP coding-agent workflow and its bounded context/query strategy.

Keep all parser, resolver, type/validation, compatibility, planning, and fallback semantics out of the MCP adapter; unsupported service capabilities must fail explicitly rather than being guessed locally.

packages.title: M11.8 Protocol Identity and Edit Preconditions.
acceptance_criteria: Preserve compiler diagnostic codes, semantic identities, document/edit versions, and explicit edit preconditions across the protocol boundary.

packages.title: M11.9 Optional LSP Protocol Library.
acceptance_criteria: Select and pin an LSP protocol library only if it reduces protocol-maintenance risk without owning language semantics.

packages.title: M11.10 Packaged Server and Client Smokes.
acceptance_criteria: Add packaged server launchers and smoke tests for VS Code plus at least one of Zed or Neovim.
